meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin tone par bina white cast chhode aur effective protection dene ke liye kai behtareen sunscreens available hain. Yeh sabhi **lightweight**, **non-greasy** aur **transparent finish** ya skin mein easily blend hone wale formulas ke sath aate hain.

Yahan kuch sabse behtareen options diye gaye hain:

### Top Sunscreens for Indian Skin (No White Cast)

| Brand & Product | Skin Type | Key Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Derma Co 1% Hyaluronic Sunscreen Aqua Gel** | All Skin Types (Especially Dry/Normal) | • Gel-based, super lightweight |
| **Fixderma Shadow SPF 50+ Cream** | All Skin Types (Sensitive friendly) | • Non-greasy aur water-resistant |
| **Minimalist Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++** | Combination / Oily Skin | • Clinical testing ke sath heavy protection |
| **Re'equil Ultra Matte Dry Touch Sunscreen Gel** | Oily / Acne-Prone Skin | • Silicone-based, velvety matte finish |
| **Aqualogica Glow+ Dewy Sunscreen** | Dull / Dry Skin | • Papaya aur Vitamin C ke sath glow deta hai |

---

### Aapke liye kaun sa best rahega?

* **Agar aapki skin Oily ya Acne-Prone hai:** **Re'equil** ya **Minimalist** try karein kyunki yeh extra oil control karte hain aur matte finish dete hain.
* **Agar aapki skin Dry ya Normal hai:** **Derma Co** ya **Aqualogica** behtar rahenge kyunki yeh skin ko moisturized rakhte hain.

Aap inme se apni skin type ke hisab se koi bhi chun sakte hain.

*Note: Kisi bhi online platform (jaise Nykaa, Amazon, ya unki official websites) ya local pharmacy se aap inhein aasani se kharid sakte hain.*
